India’s insurance penetration remains at 3.7% of GDP, about half the global average, despite rapid gains in bank account ownership. Life policy volumes have stayed flat, whilst non-life penetration stands at just 1%.
Asia’s data centre pipeline hit a record 26.5GW in H1 2026, but insurance rates still fell 5%. Rising demand for power infrastructure could eventually test the region’s ample insurance capacity.
Union Medical Benefits Society Limited (UniMed) saw its underwriting performance benefit from premium rate increases and other portfolio remediation actions, said AM Best.
The aerospace insurance market remains broadly stable as of the third quarter of 2026 but underwriters have reportedly become more selective when evaluating accounts, according to WTW.
Australian insurers face up to a $29b risk from droughts, according to Digital Agriculture Services (DAS), an agriculture fintech and geospatial data company.
Insurers will need to navigate divergences across APAC’s legal and regulatory regimes in an era when cybersecurity and data privacy regulations are rapidly evolving, according to Aon.

China Pacific Insurance Co. (H.K.) Ltd. (CPIC) is expected to have strong capital and earnings over the next two years, according to estimates by S&P Global Ratings.
Allianz Insurance Singapore has appointed Ong Bi Yung as chief executive officer, effective 1 October 2026.

Insurers are turning to facultative reinsurance to manage capital, expand capacity and enter new markets. About 60% expect to increase their use over the next two years, whilst geopolitical, cyber and climate risks remain key concerns.

Insurers can build greater trust in AI by using customer-specific data and setting clear rules for how the technology is used, analysts said. The push comes as 84% of consumers say insurers should disclose when AI is being used.

Asia-Pacific reinsurers are looking overseas for growth as abundant global capital intensifies competition and puts pressure on prices at home. Global reinsurance capital is projected to reach a record $705b in 2026, with reinsurers expected to remain selective about new markets and risks.
PT Asuransi Central Asia (ACA) is leaning towards building AI on its own data to keep customer information private, even though training such systems takes longer than using externally hosted tools.

HSBC’s $2.1b sale of its Singapore life insurance business will free up capital whilst keeping insurance on its shelves. Analysts say the deal reflects portfolio simplification rather than a broader retreat by Asian banks from insurance ownership.

Cardiac claims from non-metropolitan locations in India have risen over the past three financial years, according to data from Universal Sompo General Insurance.
Monee, the fintech arm of Shopee’s parent company Sea Limited, has partnered with Great Eastern to launch travel and motor insurance products on Shopee.
Igloo and DANA have launched DANA Rain Protection, a parametric weather insurance product in Indonesia.
The Insurance Brokers Association of India (IBAI) said that proposed insurance distribution reforms will harm policyholders, cost jobs, and reduce distribution reach in India.

Asian families are taking a more structured approach to legacy planning, with fully documented plans more than doubling to 22% in 2026. Yet 70% worry their wealth may not be preserved beyond the next generation, while only 20% feel fully prepared.

Fewer than 1 in 3 Singaporeans, or 29%, have enough savings for prolonged critical illness recovery—and even those with a plan are not confident that they have enough coverage, according to a poll by Prudential Singapore.
BIDV Insurance Joint Stock Corporation (Vietnam) (BIC) is expected to continue benefitting from good internal capital generation and a reinsurance programme mitigating risks.
Markel Insurance has appointed Kevin Leung as managing director for its Southeast Asia operations.
Chubb Life Hong Kong has launched the Chubb MyLegacy Multi-Currency Insurance Plan, which offers a customised life event settlement option and can be convertible to another currency.

Japan’s insurance market is set to grow more slowly than much of Asia, with its global premium share forecast to fall to 3.0% by 2036 from 3.9% in 2025. Allianz expects Japan’s annual growth to be 2.5% for P&C and 2.9% for life.
Igloo’s net loss narrowed by 60.4% year-on-year (YoY) in 2025, losing $6.73m (S$8.6m), based on its audited accounts released on 28 September 2026.

India’s insurance regulator’s proposed insurance distribution reforms will accelerate companies’ scaling up of their agency channels whilst introducing steep caps for general and health insurance, according to Nomura’s Global Markets Research team.
Allianz Partners has launched its next generation travel insurance ecosystem in Australia in its Metaportal platform.
Tokio Marine Holdings (TMH) remains exposed to equity risks and underwriting risks from its overseas expansion but should have enough capital to absorb losses, said AM Best.

Asian health insurers face a 12.5% rise in medical claim costs this year, as they weigh whether costly GLP-1 treatments for diabetes and obesity could reduce long-term spending on chronic diseases and hospital care.
